title: Ever had shared dreams with someone?
content: A shared dream is a dream in which you seem to have met a real person from real life. For instance, one time I dreamt I was in a white fog and for some reason, a nurse was trying to give me an injection in my foot. Same night, my mother, a doctor, dreamt she was in a white fog, and for some reason she was trying to inject the foot of a baby. I think we met in the dream. A different time we both dreamt we were not entirely welcome at a fancy dinner. When Putin launched the attack on Ukraine, I was having a nightmare with a xenophobic theme. It woke me up. I was awake, thinking the hell was that dream, and then the news notification comes it. Share your stories if you have any coincidences like this.
